cohort: The study included 200 umbilical cord blood units collected from newborns.
finding: Maternal age, birth weight, placental weight, and volume of cord blood units were identified as significant predictors for increased nucleated and CD34+ cells in cord blood, with younger maternal age and higher birth weight correlating with higher cell counts.
mod_finding: The method of delivery was not significantly correlated with total nucleated cell, mononuclear cell, or CD34+ cell counts in cord blood.
cross-section timing: At the time of cord blood collection (birth)
birth_weight: Not specified as an inclusion/exclusion criterion, but measured as a variable.
gest_age: Not specified as an inclusion/exclusion criterion, but measured as a variable and included preterm deliveries.
